'''Nardo Sau''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] antiques dealer who was a rival to the [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Angrail Ryhl]]. Sau had beaten Ryhl to several discoveries, and it was rumored that he had powerful backing on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that allowed him to cut through [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] red tape.
